findings.claim: kmctl init --path takes any path without checking it. A missing directory (a typo such as ../othr-repo) is created silently with mkdir(parents=True) and the run exits 0 reporting four created files. A path that is a file ends in an uncaught NotADirectoryError traceback instead of a one-line error naming the path. Declare the option with exists=True, file_okay=False, dir_okay=True (or check it in init and raise typer.BadParameter), and add a test for both cases.

In a repository whose .okf/index.md already exists but has no manifesto.md, init creates .okf/manifesto.md and leaves the kept index and log.md alone. The new manifesto is then not linked from the root index, and no log line names it. The run still exits 0 and prints Next as though the bundle were whole. At minimum the human output should say the kept index does not link the new manifesto (or that log.md was kept), and a test should cover the partial-bundle case.
